newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian GDP growth seen flat in Q1 - industrialists.
newsitem.headline: Italian GDP growth seen flat in Q1 - industrialists.

text.p: Italy's gross domestic product (GDP) may register around zero growth in the first quarter of 1997 as families and companies remain pessimistic about the economic outlook, industrialists' organisation Confindustria said.
In a regular report, Confindustria added that inflation might fall close to 1.5 percent year-on-year this month from 1.7 percent in April.
